parent_source: MetaWeft 598aa4f29f456c245a46130af2289dba4589818d: src/base/pipeline.py and experiment/appworld integration. Reuses shared retrieval, LLM, Elasticsearch and AppWorld executor/loader/evaluator/logging. ACE prompt parents come from the actual metaskill-appworld working files; source bytes, hashes and transformations are preserved in src/ace_adapt_reme_task/prompts/v1/parents and lineage.json. Every run copies the actual working implementation, sibling dependencies, prompts and resolved settings; a Git revision alone is not the executed-source record.
hypothesis: Learning how to adapt retrieved task knowledge may improve execution guidance and downstream reward enough to justify the additional memory-update cost. Acceptance and the two-task smoke establish operation, not a performance improvement.
intended_differences: Separate ReMe-like task knowledge from an ACE-derived adaptation playbook. Use efficiency_1 unchanged with final k=10 instead of the existing retrieval setting's five; add descriptive task-memory names without changing embeddings or ranking fields. Always make one adaptation call, including both-empty initialization. Supply the full content-only playbook to a fixed adapter prompt and one combined reflection/curation update prompt. Learn localized ADD/UPDATE edits from either outcome. This complete-system comparison is not an adaptation-only ablation or exact ACE/ReMe reproduction.
memory_structure: Task memory is a per-stream Elasticsearch bank of stable id, nonempty descriptive name, when_to_use, content, source_refs and 1024-dimensional combined vectors. Adaptation memory is separate versioned JSON with revision, monotonic entry counter and content bullets grouped by selection, specialization, composition and verification; IDs/source references are bookkeeping. Playbook entries have no applicability field, title, vector, relevance score or utility counter.
retrieval: Mandatory shared efficiency_1 preset: identity task query, combined-vector HNSW depth 20 with 40 ANN candidates, RRF constant 20 and candidate limit 20, qwen3.8-flash procedure_listwise20_v1 ranking to 20, then final k=10. Fewer than 20 candidates bypass listwise ranking; an empty bank makes no embedding/ranking call. Name is retained in selected records but excluded from embedding/ranking inputs. Adaptation memory is rendered in full without retrieval, filtering, summarization or embeddings. Consolidation separately searches five task-memory neighbors with ten ANN candidates.
adaptation: Exactly one logical temperature-zero adapter call uses fixed ACE-derived system text plus whitelisted task context, ordered retrieved records, preparation statuses and the complete rendered prior playbook. Strict JSON returns only a guidance string; empty guidance is valid. Preserve the exact request, response, validated guide, state references, prompt hashes and canonical call references. Invalid structured output produces visible degraded empty guidance without a repair call; provider/cache/logging failures remain fatal.
execution_context: Reuse the existing AppWorld ReAct executor and an exact initial copy of the parent's execution_base prompt. Attach only the fixed guide once; no within-task retrieval or guide changes. Parent controls remain qwen3.8-flash, temperature 0.9, seed 0, thinking disabled, 40 interactions, one primary trial, AppWorld environment seed 100, 120/30-second chat/embedding timeouts. Memory temperature is zero; provider retry defaults are five retries after the initial attempt and 60-second waits, with actual resolved policy captured per run.
evidence_update: Freeze and preserve both prepared inputs, prior state references, adapter event, task specification, sanitized trace and finite scalar reward before updates. Independent selectors choose the current episode for both outcomes. One task-extraction call yields zero to three named candidates; sequential evidence-grounded consolidation performs add/skip/revise/defer while preserving full supporting evidence and confirmed earlier writes. One adaptation-update call combines ACE reflection and curation using the unchanged prior full playbook and frozen episode; validate the entire ADD/UPDATE batch before application, require valid guide plus observed trajectory evidence, preserve before-images and provenance, and retain unrelated content byte-for-byte. A successful nonempty batch increments revision once. No deletion, compression, historical sampling or additional reflection rounds.
feedback_access: Retrieval sees the task instruction and preset ranking fields. Adapter sees only the current task, retrieved task records and full prior playbook. Executor sees task/API/environment observations and fixed guide. Updates see whitelisted task/step-code-observation trace, scalar reward, actual retrieved records and guide; task consolidation may inspect permitted referenced historical task evidence. Evaluator assertions, reports, private objects and reference solutions stay evaluation-only. Task and adaptation updates cannot read the other branch's new state.
memory_lifetime: Both memories start empty independently per invocation/split and persist only across the ordered stream. Initial pair is epoch 0; every completed task advances the pair epoch even after no-op updates. Split workers have separate writable state, indexes, playbooks, checkpoints and outputs. The completed LLM response cache is the sole sharing exception: no_cache by default; explicit cache/timed_cache modes are recorded. No warm-start CLI, task parallelism within a stream, training or mid-task resume.
failure_reporting: Keep both update-branch statuses visible. Ordinary schema/search failures can retain confirmed task writes or unchanged playbook with degradation; fatal provider/cache/logging/artifact/evaluation/programming errors and uncertain mutations prevent commit. Full system+user UTF-8 prompt guard is 900000 bytes: adapter overflow stops before execution, extraction/update overflow defers that branch, consolidation overflow defers its candidate. Never truncate the playbook. Optional final summary snapshot failure is an evidence gap and does not invalidate a verified pair checkpoint. Canonical accounting includes all phases, retries, failures, cache hits and inherited attempts; unknown usage/cost remains unknown.
recovery_protocol: Format 2 validates verified task and adaptation snapshots, matching role/schema/stream/epoch, full task vectors, playbook IDs/revision/counter, source references, artifact hashes and ordered completed prefix. Publish the paired checkpoint atomically after required artifacts and both snapshots. Recovery clones the immutable failed parent, restores a fresh task index and exact playbook from the last committed pair, and restarts only unfinished work using captured source/settings/data/runtime. Committed tasks perform no model calls or edits on recovery. Base/direct/retrieval retain format 1.
comparison: Closest operational comparison is retrieval --preset efficiency_1. Isolating adaptation-memory benefit requires a separately specified matched empty/frozen-playbook control with k=10 and identical task memory, prompts, executor, feedback, models, order, budgets and cache policy. No full comparison or design search is part of implementation acceptance.
